Subject: Scheduling 30m product brief — options and security attendee

Hi Evan / Priya,

Thanks again for a productive discovery today — great context on the ingestion pipeline and compliance needs. Quick recap of what we heard:
- Primary use case: near-real-time question answering over 12 months of clinical notes (PII-handling required)
- Traffic profile: bursty during business hours, expected 50k tokens/day initially
- Must-haves: tenant-level isolation, audit logs, SSO + optional Bring Your Own Key (KMS)

Next step: a 30-minute product brief for your broader stakeholders that demos the flow end-to-end and answers the KMS/SSO questions. Suggested formats: a concise product walkthrough + short Q&A (~30 min).

Please pick one of these windows (PST) that works for you — we’ll include the right technical leads depending on which slot you choose:
- Option A: Thu, Nov 26 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Option B: Fri, Nov 27 — 2:30–3:00 PM PT
- Option C: Mon, Nov 30 — 9:00–9:30 AM PT

Two quick questions for planning: can you confirm whether your InfoSec lead (Ravi Iyer) should join live? Also, would you prefer we demonstrate with a masked production trace or a pre-recorded run-through?

Attached: Redwood-OnePager-v2.pdf (high-level), mutual-action-plan-template.docx (light M.A.P. to accelerate next steps).

If any of these slots are tight, tell us a couple times that work and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — Jordan
